question: Which women should not be desired?
premises: deformed-limbed women are not to be desired
distorted-limbed women are not to be desired
even hunchbacked women are not to be desired
inference: Physical deformity marks women excluded from desire.
uncertainties: vyaṅgāṅgī nominative may be contextual rather than direct object
plain_english: One should not desire a woman with deformed or distorted limbs, nor even a hunchbacked woman.
